## The question this answers

A reading answers a question about a space. Say which question, and who asks it.

## Which seam it belongs to

- [ ] the frame, for every deployment
- [ ] a pack, for one domain
- [ ] a host, for one deployment

A change that serves one deployment and sits in the frame will be asked to move.
